evidence_quotes.O: The Panasonic RP-HC200 Noise Cancelling headphones are a pretty stylish pair of closed cup retro looking phones with oval capsules, rather than round ones making them refreshingly unique.
evidence_quotes.C: There is a place for everything in this case, organized to the tee.
evidence_quotes.E: They also come in a bunch of fun colors, how cool is that?
evidence_quotes.A: Amazon is fairly new to the computer accessory market, but not to providing quality products and good service.
evidence_quotes.N: If you don't have 4K UHD yet, don't worry, the DMPBDT330 will still play HD and SD formats.
